hooks.command: in=""; while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do in="${in}${line}"; done; q='"'; ws=${in#*${q}workspacePaths${q}*[*${q}}; if [ "$ws" = "$in" ]; then ws=""; else ws=${ws%%${q}*}; fi; _D="${ws:-${TAS_PROJECT_DIR:-${LEAN_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}}"; if [ -d "$_D/.tas" ] || [ -d "$_D/.lean_observer" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$in" | exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}/scripts/goldfish_sensor.py" --platform agy --event PostToolUse; else printf '{}\n'; fi

Stop.command: in=""; while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do in="${in}${line}"; done; q='"'; ws=${in#*${q}workspacePaths${q}*[*${q}}; if [ "$ws" = "$in" ]; then ws=""; else ws=${ws%%${q}*}; fi; _D="${ws:-${TAS_PROJECT_DIR:-${LEAN_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}}"; if [ -d "$_D/.tas" ] || [ -d "$_D/.lean_observer" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$in" | exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}/scripts/goldfish_sensor.py" --platform agy --event Stop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
